description: Defines the EmployeeEvent entity class for ORM mapping, representing employee-related events with properties such as event ID, employee number, type, specific event, notes, creation date, and creator. Includes constants for event types and actions.

classes.name: EmployeeEvent
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee event, mapped to the 'ohrm_employee_event' database table, with properties for event details, timestamps, and user info.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event, such as 'employee', 'contact', etc.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the event.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns the specific event action, e.g., 'UPDATE'.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note attached to the event.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note attached to the event.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the event was created.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the event.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the username or identifier of the creator.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the creator of the event.
